title: Computer-Assisted Self-Interviews and Health Screening in the Pediatric Emergency Department
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if an Audio-enhanced Computer-Assisted Self-Interview (ACASI) will lead to increase testing for sexually transmitted infections in youth visiting a pediatric ED
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient in the St. Louis Children's Hospital Emergency Department
* 15-21 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Evaluation of abuse or sexual assault
* Activation of the trauma system,
* Level 1 or 2 triage scores (highest severity)
* Disabilities preventing independent computer use
* Psychiatric chief complaints
* Inability to speak English
